prompt:
Create ONE complete front-facing neutral standing source painting of Klaus-Dieter Klein, a grown-up Berlin street resident for a 2D game. Reference 1 (original Hartmut portrait) is PRIMARY authority for actual Disco Elysium-like oil paint: broad dry broken irregular directional strokes, rough expressive angular adult facial planes, small tired eyes, varied edges and a few strong muddy color masses. Reference 2 (original Gisela portrait) reinforces this original portrait painting language. Borrow neither portrait's identity, clothing, background or objects. Reference 3 is Klaus-Dieter's canonical identity/outfit/hand authority ONLY; its toy proportions and smooth skin are rejected. Do not use earlier adult Klaus studies as references.

Klaus-Dieter is a stocky middle-aged man: receding chestnut-brown side-parted swept hair, heavy dark eyebrows, square jaw with dark evening stubble but NO moustache or beard, small straight nose, reserved mildly helpful CLOSED mouth and narrow weary brown eyes. Mature angular cheek/jaw structure, age lines, asymmetric eyelids, no smooth swollen cherub cheeks. His worn NAVY commuter jacket has lapels, two flap pockets and rolled-up cuffs, over a MUSTARD knitted polo shirt with short button placket. Dark navy denim trousers and substantial TAN lace-up work shoes. His anatomical LEFT hand (viewer-RIGHT in front view) holds ONE folded blank CREAM paper form at thigh level; anatomical RIGHT (viewer-LEFT) hangs EMPTY. Keep his own clothes and identifying colors. Full connected human adult arms and legs, compact mature head about one-sixth height, broad stout torso, visible waist and knees, natural substantial hands and both whole shoes on one invisible sole line. Same complete adult stature as the new painted street cast; no short mascot proportions.

Paint the face with strongly uneven warm/cool planar strokes and dark weary eyelids, not a polished realistic studio portrait or cute caricature. Paint clothes from FEW BROAD irregular fold-following oil/drybrush masses, allowing quiet unpatterned cloth between marks. No tessellation, diamond/rhombus grid, uniform repeated little facets, stipple or digital noise texture. Scuffed jacket/shoes, muted ochre/blue/gray-green Berlin palette. Serious, worn, slightly sardonic grown-up 2D painted cartoon.

ONE isolated planted FRONT whole-body figure only, head/hands/paper/feet completely inside with at least 60 pixels genuine alpha-zero margin all sides. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA outside figure. No scenery, studio background, haze, ground shadow, floor, halo, vignette, words, labels, text, extra prop, duplicate figure, panel or additional view.

Same sole line, crown height, stout mature human proportions and head size throughout. Neutral planted relaxed standing, both complete tan lace-up shoes, attached adult limbs and compact mature head about one sixth of stature. Exactly ONE folded blank cream form in his ANATOMICAL LEFT hand at thigh level: viewer-right front, viewer-left rear, far/partly hidden hand in screen-right profile, near visible hand in screen-left profile. His anatomical RIGHT hand is EMPTY. Do not move, duplicate or mirror the paper.

Keep Image 1's mature worn angular painted facial structure: uneven warm/cool planes, tired eyelids, age creases, rough stubble. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA outside the four bodies; do not reproduce the hidden brown RGB background of Image 1. No scenery, floor, shadow, haze, halos, text, labels, grid, extra props, duplicates, or cropped extremities. Four whole-body neutral direction anchors only.
